name: LinPrim Optimization
definition: Differentiable rendering optimization using L1 and SSIM loss terms from 3DGS, optimized with ADAM, backpropagating through the entire pipeline.
summary: LinPrim Optimization adjusts linear primitive parameters via differentiable backpropagation through a linear rasterizer, distinguishing itself from 3D Gaussian Splatting by handling ray-space transformations and quaternion updates.
